The online A/B test of GenRec used **approximately 10% of Netflix traffic** and ran for **4 weeks** (p. 6, Section 5.1).

The test focused on key batch-compute surfaces. It compared a Phase-2 GenRec model in a low-data, low-signals configuration against the production baseline. GenRec achieved statistically significant improvements on both short-term and long-term online metrics, including a +0.006% relative improvement on the core online metric (p. 6).
